definitions.explanation: Something that takes place at fixed intervals as a matter of established practice. Used as a noun modifier to describe regularly scheduled events.

examples.japanese: {定例|ていれい}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧です。
examples.english: The regular meeting is on Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定例|ていれい}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled the monthly routine report.

examples.japanese: {定例|ていれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new policy was announced at the regular press conference.

notes:
{定例|ていれい} means regular or routine — something that takes place at fixed intervals as established practice. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun.

ETYMOLOGY:
{定|てい} (fixed, established) + ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (custom, precedent).

COMPOUNDS:
- {定例|ていれい}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: regular meeting
- {定例|ていれい}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: routine report
- {定例|ていれい}⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧: regular press conference
- {定例|ていれい}⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧: regular general meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧: periodic, regular (broader usage — ⟦{定期|ていき}{検診|けんしん}→定期検診：15678_teikikenshin⟧, regular checkup)
- ⟦{恒例|こうれい}→恒例：12597_kourei⟧: customary, traditional (established by long practice — ⟦{恒例|こうれい}→恒例：12597_kourei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧, annual event)

REGISTER:
Formal. Commonly used in business, government, and organizational contexts.
